skill.name: handoff
skill.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.
skill.summary: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.
skill.author: mattpocock

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no suspicious patterns in the single prompt-only file. I found no semantic evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, executable code, network access, or command execution. No remediation is required.

content.value_statement: Long AI sessions lose context when another agent takes over. This skill creates a concise handoff document with current status, references, redactions, and next-session focus.
actual_capabilities: Summarizes the current conversation into a handoff document for a fresh agent.
Saves the handoff in the operating system temporary directory.
Adds a suggested skills section for the next agent.
References existing artifacts by path or URL instead of duplicating them.
Redacts API keys, passwords, and personally identifiable information.
Uses optional user arguments to tailor the handoff focus.
limitations: The result depends on the current agent having enough conversation context.
It cannot verify linked artifacts unless the agent opens those paths or URLs.
It does not replace project documentation, issues, ADRs, or commits.
File creation depends on the host agent and its filesystem permissions.

use_cases.title: Transfer a coding session
use_cases.description: Capture the current status, changed files, blockers, and next actions before another AI agent continues.

use_cases.title: Prepare async review context
use_cases.description: Create a compact transfer note that references decisions, plans, and open questions for an async reviewer.

use_cases.title: Resume research or planning work
use_cases.description: Summarize research direction, key references, and next-session focus without copying long source material.

prompt_templates.title: Basic continuation handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when another agent will continue the same task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use handoff to create a continuation note for the next agent. Include the current goal, progress, blockers, and next action.

prompt_templates.title: Focused implementation handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the next session has a clear implementation target.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a handoff focused on finishing the tests. Reference existing plans or diffs by path instead of copying them.

prompt_templates.title: Review-ready handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before a reviewer or lead picks up the work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a handoff for a code review session. Include changed areas, unresolved risks, and any files the reviewer should inspect.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced multi-artifact handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the session spans plans, decisions, diffs, and follow-up work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a detailed handoff for a multi-step project. Include suggested skills, artifact references, redaction notes, and assumptions for the next agent.

output_examples.input: Prepare the next agent to finish the test work.
output_examples.output: A concise note in the temporary directory with the current goal, test status, blockers, and referenced artifacts.

output_examples.input: Create a handoff for an async review session.
output_examples.output: A reviewer-focused handoff with changed areas, open questions, suggested skills, and redacted sensitive details.

output_examples.input: Summarize this planning session for tomorrow.
output_examples.output: A planning handoff that preserves decisions, links to source artifacts, and states the next-session focus.

best_practices: Give a clear next-session focus when invoking the skill.
Keep decisions in canonical artifacts and reference them from the handoff.
Review the handoff before sharing it outside your local environment.
anti_patterns: Do not use the handoff as the only project record.
Do not include secrets, credentials, or personal data in the requested focus.
Do not ask for full diffs or copied documents when paths are available.

faq.question: Where does the handoff document go?
faq.answer: It writes the document to the operating system temporary directory, not the current workspace.

faq.question: Can it summarize code changes?
faq.answer: Yes. It summarizes the session and points to files, diffs, commits, or plans when available.

faq.question: Does it redact sensitive data?
faq.answer: The prompt instructs the agent to redact API keys, passwords, and personally identifiable information.

faq.question: Can I guide the handoff topic?
faq.answer: Yes. Pass a short description of the next session, and the handoff will be tailored to that focus.

faq.question: Does it run commands or scripts?
faq.answer: No. The skill is prompt-only and does not bundle executable code.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
